documents.title: Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Alivus Life Sciences reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of INR 682 crores, up 16% year-on-year, driven by new product launches and healthy demand across its portfolio. The non-GPL business grew 20.8% year-on-year to contribute 79% of overall revenue, while the CDMO business reached INR 50 crores. The company reiterated its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% with expected EBITDA margins between 35% and 36%. Construction at the Solapur facility continues to progress, with Phase 1 expected to become operational in Q3 FY27. Alivus Life Sciences reported a strong Q2 FY27 with revenue growing 16.0% year-on-year to ₹6,820 million, supported by healthy demand across key markets and robust contributions from recent launches and the CDMO business.

guidance.claim: Alivus Life Sciences reiterated its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.
guidance.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to be in the 35% to 36% range for FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects to double the CDMO business over the next 3 to 4 years, making it 12% to 15% of overall revenues.
guidance.quote: Except the fact that on CDMO, we have been guiding that we will double the business from where it is today in next 3 to 4 years' time, which would effectively contribute to about between 12% to 15% of the overall revenues is how we are looking at the CDMO business.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue from operations in Q2 FY27 reached INR 682 crores, rising 16% year-on-year on new product launches and existing portfolio demand.
demand_outlook.quote: During quarter 2, revenue from operations stood at INR682 crores, up 16% year-on-year, driven by new product launches and a healthy demand across our existing portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business grew 20.8% year-on-year in Q2 FY27, contributing 79% of total revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business grew 20.8% year-on-year and now contributes 79% of our overall revenues.

demand_outlook.claim: The generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2 FY27 due to healthy demand in regulated and emerging markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Our generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.

demand_outlook.claim: CDMO revenue climbed to INR 50 crores in Q2 FY27, up 32.3% quarter-on-quarter and nearly 80% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Our CDMO business delivered a robust performance during the quarter, with revenue climbing to INR50 crores, up 32.3% quarter-on-quarter and nearly 80% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management considers the generic pricing environment to be stable.
demand_outlook.quote: So the pricing environment, I would say, is quite stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Q2 FY27 saw healthy demand across all key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2FY27 was another strong quarter for us, with revenue growing 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: GPL business performance was muted in Q1 due to inventory rationalization, registering a decline of 52.6% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization. And so if you recall, Q4 was pretty strong, and we saw a dip in Q1, a decline of 52.6% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish for the full year FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27, the business has been historically weighted towards the second half of the year and we expect a similar trend to play out this year, resulting in a stronger H2 performance.

demand_outlook.claim: Geographically, the company experienced broad-based growth across all markets during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Geographically, we saw broad-based growth across all markets during the quarter, highlighting the strength of the diversified business.

demand_outlook.claim: Chronic therapies accounted for 74% of the top line in Q1 FY27, with CVS and CNS contributing 58%.
demand_outlook.quote: Turning to the therapeutic mix, CVS and CNS continued to anchor growth during the quarter, together contributing 58% to the top line. Overall, chronic therapies accounted for 74% of top line in Q1 FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is expected to become operational in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the Taloja R&D center is progressing well and expected to be on schedule early next year.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our R&D center at Taloja is also progressing well, and we hope to be on schedule early next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex was INR 105 crores for Q2 FY27 and INR 190 crores for H1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow movement, capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has identified a portfolio of around 25 to 30 dossiers to develop over the next 3 years.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we will be building -- we've already identified a portfolio of around 25-30 dossiers that would be developed in the next 3 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Building an internal oral solids manufacturing facility would take approximately 18 to 24 months.
capex_expansion.quote: But then we feel that to protect intellectual property and to keep a good handle on quality, we might be better off if we build our own facility which would take about 18 to 24 months.

capex_expansion.claim: Brownfield capacity expansion at Ankleshwar plans an addition of approximately 100 KL capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Brownfield API / Intermediate Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Greenfield expansion at Solapur Phase 1 involves approximately 340 KL for intermediate block and backward integration.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 - ~340 KL (Intermediate block and Backward Integration) Q3 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Greenfield expansion at Solapur Phase 2 involves approximately 125 KL for API and pharma block.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 - ~125 KL (API / Pharma block) Q4 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Greenfield expansion at Solapur Phase 3 is a planned addition of approximately 535 KL.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 3 - Planned addition of ~535 KL FY29

capex_expansion.claim: Solapur facility construction continues to progress as planned and is expected to be operational in early Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capex front, Solapur continues to progress as planned. There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction at the Taloja R&D center has begun and will proceed on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the quarter stood at INR85 crores, and the company expects to incur approximately INR540 crores in total capex for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow moment, our capex for the quarter stood at INR85 crores. We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for Q2 FY27 reached 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Excluding one-time income, the adjusted EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 was approximately 39.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Excluding the onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%, reflecting improved operating efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: The company has largely been able to pass raw material price inflation onto its customers.
margins_costs.quote: Nitin, we have had a price inflation on our raw materials. But largely speaking, we've been able to pass it on to the customers.

margins_costs.claim: Solvent costs account for 10% to 12% of raw material costs and 7% to 8% of total COGS.
margins_costs.quote: The overall basket, maybe it's around 10% to 12% on our raw material cost. So on the COGS, it would be more like 7% to 8%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin was 64.4%, up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, backed by a favorable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin at 64.4%, was up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin was 28.9%, up 390 bps QoQ and 680 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margin at 28.9%, was up 390 bps QoQ & 680 bps YoY.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins for the quarter improved to 60.2%, representing a 510 basis point increase year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On the profitability front, a favourable product mix and newer launches helped improve gross margins to 60.2%, an increase in 510 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins increased by 650 basis points year-on-year to 36.6% due to enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains also supported 650 basis points Y-o-Y improvement in EBITDA margins to 36.6%.

orders_capacity.claim: Alivus Life Sciences has over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as of September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The high potent API portfolio has 30 new products representing a total addressable market of $86 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high potent API portfolio continues to advance with 30 new products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $86 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of around 160 US DMF filings, about 90 to 100 are currently contributing commercially.
orders_capacity.quote: So of the 160-odd DMFs that we have in the U.S., we are working on the -- commercially, we have about around 90 to 100 is what is contributing commercially.

orders_capacity.claim: The Ankleshwar facility contributes almost 65% of the company's revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: Ankleshwar today contributes almost 65% to our revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: The CDMO business is currently driven by 5 active projects.
orders_capacity.quote: We are still driving the CDMO business with these 5 projects, but we've seen an uptick in demand across these projects.

orders_capacity.claim: DMF and CEP filings reached a total cumulative count of 630 as on September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: DMF/CEP filings continue across major markets in Q2FY27, taking the total cumulative filings to 630 as on 30th September 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The product pipeline remains robust with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as of June 30.
orders_capacity.quote: The pipeline remains robust, with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.

orders_capacity.claim: The high-potent API portfolio has 29 products in the active grid, with 13 validated, 7 in advanced stages, and 9 in lab development.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high-potent API portfolio continues to advance with 29 products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $82 billion. Of these 13 products have been validated, 7 are in advanced stages of development and the remaining 9 products are progressing through lab development stages.

orders_capacity.claim: The CDMO business recorded a 3.8% year-on-year growth during the first quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Our CDMO business recorded 3.8% Y-o-Y growth during the first quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: The company remains net debt-free and generated free cash flow of INR 270 crores in H1 FY27, bringing cash and cash equivalents to INR 1,012 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a net debt-free company, and we have generated a strong free cash flow of INR270 crores leading to cash and cash equivalents, including short-term investments of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: ROICE expanded to approximately 34%, underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: ROICE expanded to ~34% – underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores, leading to cash and cash equivalents including short-term investments of INR880 crores as of 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Alivus Life Sciences continues to remain a debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a debt-free company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prices of crude-driven solvents pose potential headwinds to the company's cost structure.
risks_headwinds.quote: Where there are headwinds is on the prices of solvents that are driven by crude.

risks_headwinds.claim: Freight costs have increased due to the Middle East conflict, though freight remains a small overall component.
risks_headwinds.quote: We are paying more for freight, but it's a small component.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management remains watchful of the evolving geopolitical and demand environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: So while we remain watchful of the evolving geopolitical and demand environment, the strength of our business fundamentals gives us confidence in our growth outlook.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing war situation has impacted raw material prices and made management cautious regarding earnings guidance.
risks_headwinds.quote: The issue is this war situation, and what it's doing to raw material prices. So we need to be a little bit cautious.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company reiterates revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to deliver EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to double the CDMO business from current levels over the next 3 to 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: Except the fact that on CDMO, we have been guiding that we will double the business from where it is today in next 3 to 4 years' time, which would effectively contribute to about between 12% to 15% of the overall revenues is how we are looking at the CDMO business.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to deliver consistent growth supported by ongoing capacity expansion and development pipeline.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, our ongoing capacity expansion and healthy development pipeline give us confidence in sustaining this momentum and delivering consistent growth.

management_commitments.claim: Brownfield capacity addition of approximately 100 KL is planned at Ankleshwar in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Brownfield API / Intermediate Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Greenfield Solapur Phase 1 capacity of approximately 340 KL for intermediate block and backward integration is scheduled for Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 1 - ~340 KL (Intermediate block and Backward Integration) Q3 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Greenfield Solapur Phase 2 capacity of approximately 125 KL for API and pharma block is scheduled for Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 2 - ~125 KL (API / Pharma block) Q4 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Greenfield Solapur Phase 3 planned addition of approximately 535 KL is scheduled for FY29.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 3 - Planned addition of ~535 KL FY29

management_commitments.claim: Solapur facility will be operational in early Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to incur a total capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The CDMO segment is expected to gain momentum in the second half of the year supported by contributions from newly added projects.
management_commitments.quote: However, we can expect the segment to gain momentum in the second half of the year, supported by contributions from newly added projects.

management_commitments.claim: The company is guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
